items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Well, we took Gildo Mahoney, on the piano, John B. Williams on the bass, Earl Palmer on the drums, and Harry Sweets Edison as our star trumpet player.

ctx.x: To ask you if you have an overall impression of that, I'm afraid may not be a very meaningful question. But let's leave it as asked. Before we do that, tell us who you took along with you.
Well, we took Gildo Mahoney, on the piano, John B. Williams on the bass, Earl Palmer on the drums, and Harry Sweets Edison as our star trumpet player.
